name: Rogan josh
description: Kashmiri lamb curry, deep red from chilli rather than tomato.

tcm.note: Lamb with heavy chilli and warm spice — hot throughout.

ayurveda.note: Mamsa plus ushna spices; among the most heating dishes in the set.

unani.note: Garam-khushk in a high degree — winter food in the valley.

histamine.note: Yogurt-braised lamb; the chilli adds irritation on its own account.
